lines.cap: Ewe won't believe what sheep remember.
lines.say: Ewe won't believe what sheep remember.

lines.cap: People think sheep are dumb. Just a fluffy crowd that follows the leader.
lines.say: People think sheep are dumb. Just a fluffy crowd that follows the leader.

lines.cap: In 2001, scientists showed sheep photos of other sheep's faces, and rewarded them for picking the right one.
lines.say: In 2001, scientists showed sheep photos of other sheep's faces, and rewarded them for picking the right one.

lines.cap: The sheep learned to recognise fifty different faces.
lines.say: The sheep learned to recognise fifty different faces.

lines.cap: And they still remembered them, two years later.
lines.say: And they still remembered them, two years later.

lines.cap: In another study, sheep even learned to recognise famous human faces from photos.
lines.say: In another study, sheep even learned to recognise famous human faces from photos.

lines.cap: They can also tell a calm face from a stressed one, and they prefer the calm one.
lines.say: They can also tell a calm face from a stressed one, and they prefer the calm one.

lines.cap: So be nice to sheep. They'll remember you.
lines.say: So be nice to sheep. They'll remember you.
